settings.label: Service opened first
settings.help: The id of the teletext pack a caller lands in, as written in that pack's service.json. Leave empty to show the list of installed services instead. A caller can always press I to go back to the list.

settings.label: Subpage dwell (seconds)
settings.help: How long each subpage of a carousel stays up before the next one rotates in, when the page itself does not say. A page that carries its own CT timing is always obeyed instead. SPACE holds the carousel.

settings.label: Block graphics on ANSI terminals

choices.label: ASCII density - works on every terminal
Unicode sextants - needs a font with block graphics

settings.help: Teletext block graphics need Unicode sextants, which the teletext font has and the Amiga fonts do not. ASCII draws them as a coarse density instead, which every terminal can show. Teletext sessions always get real sextants whatever this says.

settings.label: Allow reveal
settings.help: Whether V reveals concealed text - quiz answers, Bamboozle solutions. Turning this off keeps a quiz honest on a shared terminal.
